21019-at-the-deathbed-of-darwinism-a-ser.title: A Series Of Papers
21019-at-the-deathbed-of-darwinism-a-ser.creator: E. DENNERT, Ph.D.
21019-at-the-deathbed-of-darwinism-a-ser.description: A book by E. DENNERT, Ph.D.. The general tendency of recent scientific literature dealing with the problem of organic evolution may fairly be characterized as distinctly and prevailingly unfavorable to the Darwinian theory of Natural Selection. In the series of chapters herewith offered for the first time to English readers, Dr. Dennert has brought together testimonies which leave no room for doubt about the decadence of the Darwinian theory in the highest scientific circles in Germany.

arxiv-2308-01507.title: The Millions of Optical - Radio/X-ray Associations (MORX) Catalogue, v2
arxiv-2308-01507.creator: Eric Wim Flesch
arxiv-2308-01507.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Eric Wim Flesch. Announcing the release v2 of the MORX (Millions of Optical-Radio/X-ray Associations) catalogue which presents probable (40%-100% likelihood) radio/X-ray associations, including double radio lobes, to optical objects over the whole sky. Detections from all the largest radio/X-ray surveys to June 2023 are evaluated, those surveys being VLASS, LoTSS, RACS, FIRST, NVSS, and SUMSS radio surveys, and Chandra , XMM-Newton , Swift , and ROSAT X-ray surveys. The totals are 3 115 575 optical objects of all classifications (or unclassified) so associated.

arxiv-2405-20816.title: Can the symmetric Fermi and eROSITA bubbles be produced by tilted jets?
arxiv-2405-20816.creator: Po-Hsun Tseng, H.-Y. Karen Yang, Chun-Yen Chen, Hsi-Yu Schive, Tzihong Chiueh
arxiv-2405-20816.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Po-Hsun Tseng, H.-Y. Karen Yang, Chun-Yen Chen, Hsi-Yu Schive, Tzihong Chiueh. The Fermi Gamma-Ray Space Telescope reveals two large bubbles in the Galaxy, extending nearly symmetrically ∼ 50 ∘ \sim 50^{\circ} above and below the Galactic center (GC). Previous simulations of bubble formation invoking active galactic nucleus (AGN) jets have assumed that the jets are vertical to the Galactic disk; however, in general, the jet orientation does not necessarily correlate with the rotational axis of the Galactic disk.

arxiv-2506-12187.title: Characterizing Neural Manifolds’ Properties and Curvatures using Normalizing Flows
arxiv-2506-12187.creator: Peter Bouss 1,2, Sandra Nestler 1,2,3, Kirsten Fischer 1,2, Claudia Merger 1,4,5, Alexandre René 1,6,7, Moritz Helias 1,4
arxiv-2506-12187.description: Abstract Neuronal activity is found to lie on low-dimensional manifolds embedded within the high-dimensional neuron space. Variants of principal component analysis are frequently employed to assess these manifolds. These methods are, however, limited by assuming a Gaussian data distribution and a flat manifold.

arxiv-2509-23139.title: Beyond Heuristics: Globally Optimal Configuration of Implicit Neural Representations
arxiv-2509-23139.creator: Sipeng Chen sc25bg@fsu.edu, Yan Zhang yzhang18@fsu.edu, Shibo Li shiboli@cs.fsu.edu
arxiv-2509-23139.description: Abstract Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) have emerged as a transformative paradigm in signal processing and computer vision, excelling in tasks from image reconstruction to 3D shape modeling. Yet their effectiveness is fundamentally limited by the absence of principled strategies for optimal configuration—spanning activation selection, initialization scales, layer-wise adaptation, and their intricate interdependencies.

arxiv-2512-19282.title: Local Topological Constraints on Berry Curvature in Spin–Orbit Coupled BECs
arxiv-2512-19282.creator: Alexander Pigazzini, Magdalena Toda
arxiv-2512-19282.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alexander Pigazzini, Magdalena Toda. We establish a local topological obstruction to flattening Berry curvature in spin-orbit-coupled Bose-Einstein condensates (SOC BECs), valid even when the global Chern number vanishes. For a generic two-component SOC BEC, the extended parameter space M = T BZ 2 × S ϕ + 1 × S ϕ − 1 M=T^{2}_{\mathrm{BZ}}\times S^{1}_{\phi_{+}}\times S^{1}_{\phi_{-}} carries a natural metric connection ∇ C \nabla^{C} whose torsion 3-form encodes the synthetic gauge fields.

This study aims to elucidate the influence of de novo purine synthesis on chemoresistance in ovarian cancer and its underlying regulatory mechanisms.

pmc-12361530.creator: Mengkai Chen, Jun Wang, Feilong Zhao, Gaopeng Jiang
pmc-12361530.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). To investigate the impact of real estate market sentiment on demand forecasting, this paper constructs a Weibo sentiment index incorporating emotional polarity and verifies its predictive advantage for market demand. Based on the Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers - Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BERT-BiLSTM) and the characteristics of China’s housing market, we classify sentiments in crawled Weibo texts and train a sentiment analysis model specifically for the Chinese real estate domain.

pmc-12454838.description: BackgroundDespite advancements in diagnostics and treatment strategies, infective endocarditis continues to carry a substantial morbidity and mortality risk. pmc-12970307.description: BackgroundSkeletal muscles play critical roles in mobility, respiratory function, and metabolic regulation by releasing myokines. Stroke survivors are particularly vulnerable to muscle wasting, known as stroke-related sarcopenia, which affects their recovery and quality of life.
